newsitem.title: CHINA: China Hua Fei set to get $265 mln loan facility.
newsitem.headline: China Hua Fei set to get $265 mln loan facility.

text.p: A $265 million syndicated credit is expected to be finalised this week for China-based Hua Fei Colour Display Systems Co, co-arranger CCIC Finance Ltd said on Monday.
The credit consists of a five-year term loan of $200 million and a $65 million working capital loan, CCIC Finance managing director Francois Van Reepinghen told reporters.
China Hua Fei, based in Nanjing, makes colour television tubes and other electronic products. It is a joint venture between Chinese interests and N.V. Philips of the Netherlands.
Interest on the term loan is LIBOR plus 100 basis points. There were no details on the working capital portion.
CCIC Finance is a joint venture grouping First Chicago NBD Corp's First National Bank of Chicago unit, the Industrial Bank of Japan, Bank of China and China Resources (Holdings) Co Ltd.
ABN-Amro Bank is the other co-arranger.
